\begin{table}[pos=t]
\centering
\caption{Verification, in five checks of five different things. Block~1 compares the exact horizon expectation of Section~\ref{sec:interaction} with a Monte-Carlo estimate of the same payoff matrix: root-mean-square error over the sixteen ordered pairs and eight independent replicates, which decays at the Monte-Carlo rate $N^{-1/2}$ and which the exact route removes. Block~2 checks the arithmetic, not the formula: it compares the stabilised evaluation of~\eqref{eq:fixation} in double precision with the same sum evaluated in $60$-digit arithmetic, worst relative error over those of the $n(n-1)=756$ ordered pairs whose fixation probability is representable as a normal double, $738$ at $\beta=0.05$ and $589$ at $\beta=0.2$. Block~3 checks the closed form itself against an independent implementation of the same birth-death formula in EGTtools, on the depth-zero design space, worst absolute difference over all ordered pairs. Block~4 compares the small-mutation reduction with the full mutation--selection chain on a design space small enough for it ($n=3$, $Z=40$, $861$ population states); both sides use the process average $\sum_{i}x_{i}u(i,i)$ of Section~\ref{sec:observables}. Block~5 compares the complete stationary vector and both unsafe observables with a $60$-digit reference at the baseline and hardest selection settings.}
\label{tab:verification}
